content: Hello, I'm Dr. Morgan. How can I support you today?
I've been feeling really overwhelmed with this new wellness app I started using. It's supposed to help, but I keep running into glitches and it's making me more stressed.
I'm sorry to hear that you're having this experience. I reassure you that your feelings are completely valid, and I'm here to help you work through these frustrations.
It's hard to trust that this app will actually make a difference when it keeps crashing or freezing at important moments.
Don't worry, you can trust me to guide you in managing this situation. We can explore strategies to reduce your stress and also discuss how to address these technical issues effectively.
That sounds good, but I'm worried I'm just wasting time if this keeps happening.
It's completely understandable to feel that way. I want you to know that your efforts are worthwhile, and together we'll find ways to make this process feel more manageable and supportive.
I appreciate that. I'd like to try focusing on the parts that help rather than getting stuck on the glitches.
Absolutely. I reassure you that focusing on progress, not perfection, is a healthy approach. I'm here to support you every step of the way.
